create_NewModelGroupRequest: create a NewModelGroupRequest with an access group name and optional model names or model ids
create_UpdateModelGroupRequest: create an UpdateModelGroupRequest with updated model names or model ids for an existing access group
create_DeleteModelGroupResponse: create a DeleteModelGroupResponse with access group, models updated count, and message
create_AccessGroupInfo: create an AccessGroupInfo with access group name, model names list, and deployment count
create_ListAccessGroupsResponse: create a ListAccessGroupsResponse containing a list of AccessGroupInfo objects
